title: Transport and Congestion
description: Reliability, windows, and how senders share a pipe they cannot see. TCP first; QUIC as a later design that learned the same lessons.

sourceReferences.title: Stanford CS144
sourceReferences.notes: Labs build a reliable transport. Congestion is a mechanism, not a slogan.
